Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 10

Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Deepak Tijori was born earlier than Harry Piel based on the ages at film release. The Planner stated that Deepak Tijori was older at the release of his film, which led to the conclusion that he was born earlier. However, the task was to compare birth years, not ages at film release. Harry Piel was born in 1892, and Deepak Tijori was born in 1961, so Harry Piel was actually born earlier. The mistake occurred when the Planner compared ages at release rather than birth years.
